name: agent-design-studio
description: Turn one brief into a reviewed system design as a clickable HTML view and a PDF, with a coding-agent handoff.

interface.shortDescription: One brief to a reviewed HTML and PDF system design
interface.longDescription: Builds a reviewed design covering brief and scope, task map, building blocks, flow, stack and permissions, models and cost, risks, tests, rollout and handoff. Delivers a read-only clickable DESIGN.html and a DESIGN.pdf from the same design.json. Uses the host assistant with no extra API key.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-design-studio to turn this brief into a reviewed design: DESIGN.html, DESIGN.pdf and a coding-agent handoff.
